Cloud pale #CEDBDE, a restrained #92AAB8 shade only on bottom edge and lower-right, no diagonal mountain shadow. Gold sun #E8B753, upper-left highlight #FFF0B0, outline #202936. No detached rays or stray flecks. No rain, snow, text or secondary symbols. Equal square pixels, same dark one-pixel outline throughout. Variant G, with clear cloud humps and deep notches surviving downsampling.
